why_v2_is_better: The group no longer feels like five highly responsive television characters continuously feeding each other good lines.
Several conversational attempts simply stop, which makes the weak-tie texture more credible.
Xu Hang and Song Nan are introduced without converting the introduction into immediate professional chemistry.
Tang Yu, Lin Jing and Chen Lan remain legible while being allowed to be tired, brief or unavailable.
The trip does not reward the reader with a lesson, decision, emotional confession or symbolic ending.
The final separation at the transit point leaves the social unit loose rather than falsely cohesive.
acceptable_losses: v2 is less witty and contains fewer individually memorable lines.
the chapter has deliberately low plot leverage.
some readers may initially wonder why the trip matters; later repetitions and weak-tie consequences should answer only part of that question.
remaining_risks: If many later ordinary chapters use meals, travel logistics and phones in the same way, restraint itself will become a formula.
Song Nan is still the easiest social-energy carrier in the group; later scenes must allow her to be withdrawn, impatient, wrong or simply absent.
The chapter must not be retroactively overloaded with significance merely because Song Nan and Xu Hang later have consequential interactions.
The prose should preserve a little sensory and social specificity in later revision; subtraction must not flatten every ordinary scene into neutral reporting.

campbell_negative_space.long_arc_seed: weak ties and distinct social rhythms exist before they become useful

opening_sequence_comparison.chapter1: task pressure, private shame and a quiet Call; narrow focal field
opening_sequence_comparison.chapter2: social expansion, ordinary time and weak ties; deliberately diffuse field
opening_sequence_comparison.chapter3: institutional friction, status discomfort and concrete labor; stronger interpersonal pressure
opening_sequence_comparison.risk: do not let chapter3 retroactively make chapter2 feel like networking setup

next_recommendation: Confirm the three-chapter opening order. Do not rewrite chapter 2 for extra plot. Move to chapter 4 or perform a first-three-chapter continuity pass before further full drafting.
